name: How much does spray foam insulation cost for a typical home?

mainEntity.name: How much does spray foam insulation cost for a typical home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of spray foam insulation varies significantly based on factors such as the size of the area to be insulated, the type of spray foam (open-cell or closed-cell), and the complexity of the installation. Closed-cell foam typically costs more per square foot but offers a higher R-value and moisture resistance. We provide customized quotes after a detailed assessment of your home's specific needs and the scope of work required to ensure accuracy for your project in areas like Huntington Beach or Irvine.
